answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the marble beacon after the epoch ends and the falcon nonce differs from the first. Since the umber audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 26% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
